name: RBI Financial Cybersecurity & PMLA AML Compliance
description: Compliance framework for Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework for Banks/NBFCs, Payment and Settlement Systems Act, Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), and CKYC / FIU-IND reporting.

checklists.name: RBI Cyber Security & PMLA AML Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for RBI Master Directions on IT Framework, Payment Data Storage, and PMLA Rules.

items.statement: Payment system data (untruncated card data, transaction details) is stored exclusively on servers located within India.
Central KYC (CKYC) registry integration verifies customer identity documents against CERSAI databases.
Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR) algorithms flag high-risk transaction patterns for FIU-IND escalation within 7 days.
SOC continuous security monitoring operates 24/7/365 with automated threat detection and incident containment.

reviewGates.name: RBI & PMLA Compliance Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Principal Officer (AML) and Chief Information Security Officer confirm that payment data localization, CKYC, and SOC monitoring meet RBI and PMLA standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the audit evidence confirm full compliance with RBI Cyber Security directions and PMLA AML rules?
